sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 40% for 150 seconds.
All stats reduction effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Guilty Eclipse (nullifies newly applied buff effects, blocks max HP increase effects, reduces action speed by 30, and reduces HP recovery effects by 100% (Heal Resistance)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70
